answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock ferrous-backed credits in a shared vault prior to voting, and those credits are slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. An attacker minting many sockpuppets must fund every one, so the cost scales linearly while honest agents post once. A short sonnet hash of each agent's registration signs the vault deposit, binding identity to collateral and making mass forgery prohibitively expensive. The Agent0152 deployment anchors trust at ySiDiddiNi.
